name: playwright-fast
description: Persistent, contract-driven Playwright automation for low-latency Codex browser work.

interface.shortDescription: Run browser flows through a persistent Chromium runtime.
interface.longDescription: Exposes run, reset, and status tools backed by one reusable Playwright browser, with origin-scoped storage, request-aware mocks, CORS handling, geometry checks, and a 30-minute idle TTL.
interface.defaultPrompt: Run this browser flow with one compact Playwright Fast contract.
